author: Claude (Claude Code session, 22 Oct 2026), from metadata + cover frames
note: visual_opening describes the cover frame (the image YouTube serves), not a verified first frame. First spoken sentences were not reachable (YouTube bot check on datacenter IPs).

youtube:1yWPZBZLkIs.subject: availability, burnout, boundaries
youtube:1yWPZBZLkIs.narrative_format: explainer over stock office footage, burned-in captions
youtube:1yWPZBZLkIs.visual_opening: Cover frame: woman at an office desk, large captions ('cannot prove that email causes burnout'). Stock-style B-roll, no presenter.
youtube:1yWPZBZLkIs.why: Names a cost the viewer pays daily but has never priced. 'Psychological cost' promises a diagnosis, and 'being available' is something they did an hour ago.
youtube:1yWPZBZLkIs.adaptation: You reply within a minute. Here's what that's been teaching people.
youtube:1yWPZBZLkIs.first_frame: Phone face-up on a dark desk, screen lighting up, no hands
youtube:1yWPZBZLkIs.music: low room tone, single soft piano note on the turn

tiktok:7698791827926830349.subject: Stoic habits to drop
tiktok:7698791827926830349.narrative_format: talking head list (Daily Stoic, cross-posted to YouTube Shorts)
tiktok:7698791827926830349.visual_opening: No cover on this route (TikTok). The YouTube cross-post's cover shows Ryan Holiday walking on a winter beach, caption 'But it's warmer'.
tiktok:7698791827926830349.why: 'Stop doing' turns advice into a correction, and 'according to the Stoics' borrows authority. 15.8x his TikTok median. The same video is 2.4x on YouTube, so platform matters.
tiktok:7698791827926830349.adaptation: Stop explaining yourself to people committed to misreading you.
tiktok:7698791827926830349.first_frame: Slate card, single Bone line, Ember underline on 'explaining'

youtube:exzb26kBpA8.subject: Marcus Aurelius on getting up (Meditations 5.1)
youtube:exzb26kBpA8.visual_opening: Cover frame: Ryan Holiday close-up on a cold beach, caption '"But it's warmer"' (the Meditations 5.1 objection).
youtube:exzb26kBpA8.why: A famous name plus an everyday struggle. The caption quotes the inner excuse ('but it's warmer'), which is emotional recognition inside an authority hook.
youtube:exzb26kBpA8.adaptation: It's 6:40. You've hit snooze twice. An emperor argued with the same blanket.
youtube:exzb26kBpA8.first_frame: Grey dawn through a curtain gap, unmade bed edge
youtube:exzb26kBpA8.music: cold wind bed, one low cello tone

youtube:FIPDQ78MfjM.subject: not getting upset (Stoic judgement)
youtube:FIPDQ78MfjM.visual_opening: Cover frame: man in cap and sunglasses at dusk, caption 'Things are not asking' (Marcus, Meditations: things don't ask to be judged).
youtube:FIPDQ78MfjM.why: 'The secret to never...' is a big promise. It works because the payoff is one sentence the viewer can test on today's annoyance.
youtube:FIPDQ78MfjM.adaptation: You're not upset about what they said. You're upset about what you decided it meant.
youtube:FIPDQ78MfjM.first_frame: Unread message notification on a dark lock screen
youtube:FIPDQ78MfjM.music: room tone, a breath before card 2

youtube:06O2mC2SW8g.subject: is depression a chemical imbalance (podcast clip)
youtube:06O2mC2SW8g.emotional_trigger: doubt about a belief they hold
youtube:06O2mC2SW8g.narrative_format: podcast clip, guest question on screen
youtube:06O2mC2SW8g.visual_opening: Cover frame: woman at a podcast mic, top caption 'Is Depression a Neurochemical Imbalance?', yellow word-by-word captions.
youtube:06O2mC2SW8g.why: A yes/no question about something the viewer was told as fact. The answer feels like it will update a belief.
youtube:06O2mC2SW8g.adaptation: Moodius won't make medical claims. Same shape, our ground: 'Is being "too sensitive" a flaw, or information?'
youtube:06O2mC2SW8g.first_frame: Slate question card, Playfair, Ember rule

youtube:lKIg6YaXFnI.subject: depression vs personal responsibility
youtube:lKIg6YaXFnI.visual_opening: Cover frame: therapist on a video call with Dr K at the mic, caption 'therapists working private practice' and 'Oh my God.'
youtube:lKIg6YaXFnI.why: Two words the viewer feels are in conflict, set against each other. The 'vs' promises a ruling on a fight they have with themselves.
youtube:lKIg6YaXFnI.adaptation: Grief vs self-pity. One question tells them apart.
youtube:lKIg6YaXFnI.first_frame: Two Bone words either side of a thin Ember line on Slate
youtube:lKIg6YaXFnI.music: two alternating low notes, one per word

youtube:DIfCFnJC7cg.subject: what a therapist actually does
youtube:DIfCFnJC7cg.visual_opening: Cover frame: 'POV: Talking to my therapist' caption over a woman speaking, Dr K in the corner.
youtube:DIfCFnJC7cg.why: Insider reveal: the job everyone has an idea of, explained by someone inside it. POV framing puts the viewer in the chair.
youtube:DIfCFnJC7cg.adaptation: A good friend doesn't fix you. They let you hear yourself. (Moodius opinion, not therapy advice.)
youtube:DIfCFnJC7cg.first_frame: Two coffee cups on a café table, one chair empty
youtube:DIfCFnJC7cg.music: café murmur ducked under a soft piano

youtube:k7ejvsP297E.subject: a psychiatrist who stopped giving answers
youtube:k7ejvsP297E.narrative_format: interview clip, older expert, warm room
youtube:k7ejvsP297E.visual_opening: Cover frame: grey-bearded psychiatrist mid-sentence, warm wood background, yellow captions.
youtube:k7ejvsP297E.why: A professional doing the opposite of what you'd expect from his job is a built-in reversal.
youtube:k7ejvsP297E.adaptation: Socrates never handed anyone an answer. That was the whole method. (Idea: Plato's dialogues · Moodius words)
youtube:k7ejvsP297E.first_frame: Marble-free: a candle-lit desk, an open notebook with one question
youtube:k7ejvsP297E.music: quiet, a single bell tone on the reveal

youtube:IlD3UoV6DKY.subject: certainty and danger
youtube:IlD3UoV6DKY.visual_opening: Cover frame: same psychiatrist, captions 'PEOPLE WHO THINK THEY' in white and green.
youtube:IlD3UoV6DKY.why: 'People who...' lets the viewer place someone they know, or themselves. It's a portrait, so they check whether it fits.
youtube:IlD3UoV6DKY.adaptation: People who are always certain are often the most frightened person in the room. (Moodius opinion)
youtube:IlD3UoV6DKY.first_frame: Silhouette at a window, city at night

tiktok:7692579379729157390.subject: perception and distortion
tiktok:7692579379729157390.visual_opening: No cover on this route (TikTok). Caption: 'Perception can easily be distorted ...'.
tiktok:7692579379729157390.why: Short, calm claim about the viewer's own mind. It's an ambient, text-led account, the closest format to Moodius in the set.
tiktok:7692579379729157390.adaptation: You didn't see what happened. You saw what you were afraid of. (Idea: Epictetus, Enchiridion 5 · Moodius words)

tiktok:7698790535267405070.subject: dealing with difficult people
tiktok:7698790535267405070.visual_opening: No cover on this route (TikTok). Caption: 'Five Stoic strategies for dealing with difficult people'.
tiktok:7698790535267405070.why: Another person plus a conflict, the topic that held best on Moodius (43% median past 3 s). The list opener is the weak part on our own account.
tiktok:7698790535267405070.adaptation: They were rude to you today. There are two ways to read it. (two-branch, no list)
tiktok:7698790535267405070.first_frame: A closed door in a dim corridor
tiktok:7698790535267405070.music: tense low string, released on the second branch

youtube:OL85T7jryNE.subject: loneliness among people
youtube:OL85T7jryNE.visual_opening: Cover frame: two silhouettes facing a red sun over the sea, small italic text 'Have you ever felt lonely around people you actually know?'.
youtube:OL85T7jryNE.why: Names a feeling people think is only theirs. Text-over-image with no face, so it's the format Moodius already makes.
youtube:OL85T7jryNE.adaptation: Lonely at a full table. Nobody noticed, because you were laughing.
youtube:OL85T7jryNE.first_frame: Long table after dinner, warm light, one chair turned away
youtube:OL85T7jryNE.music: muffled dinner chatter fading to silence

youtube:_wUWUT0Bwow.subject: reading as escape
youtube:_wUWUT0Bwow.visual_opening: Cover frame: woman reading in a cypress garden, text 'When the book in my hands turns into ... Sorry, I'll be ignoring everyone for the next 24 hours'.
youtube:_wUWUT0Bwow.why: A 'when you...' moment readers recognise, made funny. It's highly shareable ('this is me').
youtube:_wUWUT0Bwow.adaptation: Some evenings a book is the only room where nobody needs anything from you.
youtube:_wUWUT0Bwow.first_frame: Armchair, lamp, an open book face-down
youtube:_wUWUT0Bwow.music: quiet room, page turn, soft ambient

youtube:NNyePAkfjNs.subject: self-awareness before change
youtube:NNyePAkfjNs.visual_opening: Cover frame: psychiatrist, caption 'I'M CONSTANTLY' (green highlight).
youtube:NNyePAkfjNs.why: Tells the viewer the obstacle is a blind spot, and implies the next lines will show it.
youtube:NNyePAkfjNs.adaptation: You've apologised for the same thing three times this year. That's not bad luck.
youtube:NNyePAkfjNs.first_frame: A notebook page with the same sentence written three times
youtube:NNyePAkfjNs.music: low drone, a click on each repeated line

youtube:u_lrHzjZgL0.subject: usefulness and loneliness
youtube:u_lrHzjZgL0.visual_opening: Cover frame: psychiatrist, caption 'ABLE TO BUILD SHELTER'.
youtube:u_lrHzjZgL0.why: A cultural question that turns into a personal one ('lonely and lost').
youtube:u_lrHzjZgL0.adaptation: When did you last do something useless with someone you love?
youtube:u_lrHzjZgL0.first_frame: Two people's shoes on a pier, feet dangling
youtube:u_lrHzjZgL0.music: gulls and water, gentle guitar harmonics

youtube:HwiKlYXBGPI.subject: Stoic habits to drop (YouTube version of #2)
youtube:HwiKlYXBGPI.visual_opening: Cover frame: Ryan Holiday mid-gesture in front of bookshelves, caption 'don't have to'.
youtube:HwiKlYXBGPI.why: Same video as #2 on YouTube: 2.4x here vs 15.8x on TikTok. The hook works on both, but the size of the lift depends on the platform.
youtube:HwiKlYXBGPI.adaptation: Stop rehearsing arguments with people who aren't in the room.
youtube:HwiKlYXBGPI.first_frame: Empty kitchen at night, kettle light on
youtube:HwiKlYXBGPI.music: silence, then a single kettle click

youtube:Da10z9ApAd8.subject: death awareness makes days count
youtube:Da10z9ApAd8.narrative_format: re-cut clip of a well-known speaker with captions (rights unclear)
youtube:Da10z9ApAd8.visual_opening: Cover frame: Jordan Peterson at a podcast mic, top caption 'How Often Do You Think About Death?', subtitle 'MIND ALL THE TIME'. A re-upload of another person's interview.
youtube:Da10z9ApAd8.why: The paradox: thinking about death to enjoy life. The cover question is personal and slightly confronting. Flag: the channel re-uses someone else's footage, which Moodius never does.
youtube:Da10z9ApAd8.adaptation: Count the visits, not the years. (Idea: Seneca, Letters 12 · Moodius words)
youtube:Da10z9ApAd8.first_frame: A father's coat on a hook by a door
youtube:Da10z9ApAd8.music: slow ticking clock under a held chord

youtube:CTQUKsYb-sg.subject: relationships
youtube:CTQUKsYb-sg.visual_opening: Cover frame: cartoon butler in a tux, caption 'SOMEONE' in yellow.
youtube:CTQUKsYb-sg.why: 'Most people learn too late' is a curiosity gap plus a warning. Viewers don't want to be the ones who learned late.
youtube:CTQUKsYb-sg.adaptation: Love doesn't fix what you refuse to name.
youtube:CTQUKsYb-sg.first_frame: Two cups on a table, one untouched and cold
youtube:CTQUKsYb-sg.music: muted piano, one wrong note left unresolved

youtube:9jTu-zrCNhY.subject: reading for status vs use
youtube:9jTu-zrCNhY.narrative_format: talking head with text on background
youtube:9jTu-zrCNhY.visual_opening: Cover frame: Ryan Holiday with '700 essays' caption, page of text behind him.
youtube:9jTu-zrCNhY.why: Calls out a habit the audience is proud of (owning books). The hook flatters and stings at once.
youtube:9jTu-zrCNhY.adaptation: You underlined it three years ago. Did you ever do it?
youtube:9jTu-zrCNhY.first_frame: Close-up of a pencil underline in an old book

youtube:9oO_ktZgzlo.subject: attachment: chaos vs calm love
youtube:9oO_ktZgzlo.narrative_format: talking head reading a viewer comment
youtube:9oO_ktZgzlo.visual_opening: Cover frame: Dr K reading a long viewer comment screenshot, caption 'the regret'.
youtube:9oO_ktZgzlo.why: Asks why a feeling is backwards (chaos = safe). The answer promises to explain the viewer's own relationship history.
youtube:9oO_ktZgzlo.adaptation: Calm love can feel boring if you grew up on chaos. (Idea: attachment theory, Bowlby 1969 · Moodius words)
youtube:9oO_ktZgzlo.first_frame: Still lake at dawn, no wind
